data.title: Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Meets with UK Minister of State
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Cabinet Member, Climate Envoy, and Commissioner General of Expo 2030 Riyadh Adel Al-Jubeir met yesterday in London with UK Minister of State for the Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan, and Pakistan at the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) Stephen Doughty during Al-Jubeir's official visit to the United Kingdom.
    During the meeting, they reviewed relations between the two friendly countries and discussed regional developments and ongoing efforts to address them.
    -- SPA
05:31 Local Time 02:31 GMT
